body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Battery-Biz, a manufacturer of CE products including PC, power adapters, digital camera/camcorder, came out with ‘Power FM’ during 2007 CES Unveiled. It features FM Transmitter, extended rechargeable battery, and protective case.
The ‘Power FM’ is only available at online store Amazon.com for now and is expected to be on the U.S. mass market around this June.
